crop.notes: The clipping is the whole 'PERSONAL AND NEWS' column of unrelated items; only the highlighted paragraph beginning 'Tom Allen, the pugilist, was arrested in Cleveland' (in crop-1) is about Allen.

ocr.notes: The Allen paragraph matches the image exactly.

title.suggested: Allen Arrested in Cleveland for Training

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen was arrested in Cleveland for violating the prize-fighting laws, but the court ruled that training for a prize fight was not illegal and discharged him.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican—St. Louis, December 31, 1868' (Thursday). The current title is just the column heading.

facts.fact: Allen was arrested in Cleveland, charged with violating the prize-fighting laws; the court held that training for a prize fight did not break Ohio law and discharged him

notes: The arrest was 'on Wednesday'; which Wednesday is not clear from a Thursday paper reprinting news, so the fact date is left as 1868-12.
